# PLAY DATA SAFETY DECLARATIONS

**L-12.** What to enter in the Play Console's Data Safety form, derived from the same
notice the app shows before an account is created.

> **The category labels are a JUDGEMENT and must be confirmed in the Console (H7).**
> Google's taxonomy is theirs and it changes. Everything else on this page - what is
> collected, why, whether it is required, how long it is kept - is derived from the
> notice and cannot drift from it.

## The summary answers

| Question | Answer | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Does your app collect or share any of the required user data types? | **Yes** | 8 items, listed below |
| Is all of the user data collected by your app encrypted in transit? | **Yes** | TLS 1.3 only; cleartext is refused |
| Do you provide a way for users to request that their data be deleted? | **Yes** | In the app, and at `swafto.app/delete-account` with the app uninstalled |
| Is any data shared with third parties? | **No** | No analytics SDK, no advertising SDK, no third party receives personal data |
| Is any data processed ephemerally? | **No** | What is collected is stored, and the retention column says for how long |
| Is data collection required to use the app? | **Partly** | Only the account-and-ledger purpose is required; the other two are refusable |

## The data types

| Play data type | Collected | Shared | Required | Purpose | From the notice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Personal info · Phone number | Yes | No | Yes | Account management, App functionality | account_and_ledger - "mobile number" |
| Personal info · Other info | Yes | No | Yes | App functionality | account_and_ledger - "shop name" |
| Financial info · Other financial info | Yes | No | Yes | App functionality | account_and_ledger - "the entries you type" |
| Personal info · Names | Yes | No | Yes | App functionality | account_and_ledger - "customer and supplier names you enter" |
| Personal info · Phone number | Yes | No | No | Account management, App functionality | sms_reminders - "mobile number" |
| App info and performance · Diagnostics | Yes | No | No | Crash reporting, Diagnostics | crash_diagnostics - "device model" |
| App info and performance · Diagnostics | Yes | No | No | Crash reporting, Diagnostics | crash_diagnostics - "app version" |
| App info and performance · Crash logs | Yes | No | No | Crash reporting | crash_diagnostics - "the point in the app where it stopped" |

## Why each mapping was chosen

- **Personal info · Phone number** - It is the account identifier and the sign-in channel.
- **Personal info · Other info** - A shop name can identify a sole trader, so it is treated as personal info rather than as a label.
- **Financial info · Other financial info** - Takings, purchases and expenses. Not a payment instrument and not a transaction with us - no money moves through SWAFTO.
- **Personal info · Names** - Third-party personal data, recorded on the shopkeeper's instruction. AD-006: he is the Fiduciary for it and we are the Processor.
- **Personal info · Phone number** - It is the account identifier and the sign-in channel.
- **App info and performance · Diagnostics** - Optional, and only when crash reporting is switched on.
- **App info and performance · Diagnostics** - Optional, and only when crash reporting is switched on.
- **App info and performance · Crash logs** - Never carries an amount, a customer name or a phone number. B36 is the check.

## Retention, as declared

- **account_and_ledger** (required): kept while the account is in use; erased within 90 days of a deletion request, or of 24 months of inactivity
- **sms_reminders** (optional): the number is kept only while the account exists
- **crash_diagnostics** (optional): never includes an amount, a customer name or a phone number

Deletion takes effect after a **30-day grace period** during which
signing in cancels it. After that, encrypted backups rotate out within 90 days and are
never restored.

## The URLs the form asks for

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Privacy policy | `https://swafto.app/privacy` (`apps/web/legal/privacy.html`) |
| Account deletion | `https://swafto.app/delete-account` (`apps/web/delete-account/index.html`) |

Both must be **live** before submission. Publishing them is H5; the pages exist.

## What this page deliberately does not claim

- That the Console has been filled in. It has not; that needs an account (H7).
- That Google's category names are exactly these. Confirm them against the form.
- That the policy has been reviewed by counsel. It has not (H9), and it says so on
  its own first screen.
